subject: FW: 2-3y postdoc position in avian dispersal

messages.subject: FW: 2-3y postdoc position in avian dispersal
parts:
Dear all,

colleagues at my institute are looking for somebody doing cool movement modeling.

Best regards  --- Marc


At the Swiss Ornithological Institute, we are recruiting a 2-3-year post-doc who will capitalize on long-term tracking projects to understand decision making and fitness consequences during avian dispersal. We are looking for candidates with a PhD in ecology, and a strong interest in movement ecology, biostatistics and conservation biology. Ideally, candidates have a very strong analytical background in analyzing animal movement and spatial modelling.

 

More information about the project and how to apply:

https://www.vogelwarte.ch/de/vogelwarte/mitarbeit/thesis/post-doc/post-doctoral-researcher-in-avian-dispersal-ecology

 

Deadline for applications 31st of December.
